fact: The article states that, over the March 2019 to January 2020 period it describes, the Sanatorium Hospital of Luanda and the Anti-Tuberculosis Dispensary of Luanda collected clinical data entirely on paper medical records and registries, and that the tuberculosis-only electronic medical record developed for the two had not yet been piloted.
title: Improving TB Surveillance and Patients' Quality of Care Through Improved Data Collection in Angola: Development of an Electronic Medical Record System in Two Health Facilities of Luanda
